content:
The even integers from 2 to 2022 inclusive form \(2022/2 = 1011\) terms.

Pair the terms from the start:
\[
(2-4)+(6-8)+\cdots+(2018-2020)+2022
\]
There are \(1010\) terms from 2 to 2020, giving \(505\) pairs, each equal to \(-2\):
\[
505(-2)+2022 = -1010+2022 = 1012
\]

\[
\boxed{1012}
\]
